messages:
Ivy Park: Quick check-in  Emeraldlyze case study. Raw audio + transcript in Drive. Target publish Thu 11/11 09:00 PT (embargo). Need quote sign-off, legal review for benchmark phrasing, and landing page owner.
Connor Hale: I'll take quote sign-off and landing copy. Draft hero quote from interview: "Redwood reduced our median inference latency and helped us ship smarter search much faster." Sending to customer for approval.
Rhea Sharma: Creative can produce hero image (customer screenshot), three social cards, 15s + 45s promo clips, and a gated one-pager. ETA for assets after legal greenlight: 48h.
LegalBot: Started legal review. Please attach benchmark methodology and test ID. Benchmarks must be phrased as "approximately Xx" or "approximately X%" and avoid competitor names. Redact PII before publishing.
ProductOps: Ops note: set HubSpot form to tag leads "emeraldlyze-case-2026" and route to AE + CS. Recommend gating the one-pager to improve lead quality.
Connor Hale: Customer replied: approved the revised quote but asked to remove "much" and prefer "helped us ship features faster." Approved hero quote now: "Redwood reduced our median inference latency and helped us ship features faster." Signed release uploaded.
LegalBot: Verified signed release uploaded: https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/emeraldlyze/RELEASE_4087654488.pdf. Legal requests phrasing for benchmarks as: "approximately 2.0x median latency improvement" and "approximately 30% lower cost per token" citing test ID EL-2026-09. Redactions completed.
Rhea Sharma: Creative note: will avoid absolute visuals and will include method blurb per legal. I'll deliver hero + social cards + clips with captions and transcript. ETA Fri EOD.
Connor Hale: Landing draft ready for customer preview. I'll include benchmark callout and methodology citation EL-2026-09. Posting link here when live.
ProductOps: HubSpot form created and routing configured. UTMs set and gated one-pager workflow wired to nurture.
Ivy Park: Embargo noted. Customer preview scheduled Mon 11/08. Final publish after customer preview and 11/11 09:00 PT embargo. Thanks team. :rocket:
